decisions.reason: Locates partial/runningCalls/turnEnds reads in Pet.tsx; explains the temporary views.get('chat')?.legacy projection, the move of turn history to chat.timeline, and the typed useChat/ChatSnapshot target with order + nodes.get(id), plus why turnEnds cannot stay on legacy.

Locates running at Pet.tsx:19 and explains it is a lifecycle field belonging to the useSession seat, deliberately outside the chat legacy projection, and keeps the existing useSession call rather than renaming it.

Locates the deleted dsh-client-runtime imports (index.ts:6 ClientContext, Pet.tsx:8 ConversationSnapshot) and the package.json client.inject entry; repoints Context as ClientContext to scoped @deepseek-ai/cordis and snapshot types to their owning ui-chat package, without claiming cordis exports every snapshot type.

Locates the scoped slots.register call, explains the apply-order race and the slots.inject wrapping, the renderer-owned ctx.slots declaration and client Context augmentation via type-only imports, while preserving the slot name and registration payload.

Ties the snapshot/lifecycle/slot changes to DSH-0.1.2-A1-03 with explained reasoning, cleanly separates the staged legacy projection from immediate type/inject/lifecycle switches, and uses DSH-0.1.2-A1-25 as the package-removal card; card IDs are backed by mounted references, not bare IDs.
